description: Adds projects (photos + details) to the Projects section of a Houzz Pro profile. Feed it a batch of projects; it logs in once, uploads everything, and reports per-project results to the dataset.

addProjectUrl.description: Required. In your own browser (logged into Houzz), open your professional profile's Projects section, click 'Add Project', and paste that page's URL here. The actor starts every upload from this page.
addProjectUrl.title: Houzz 'Add Project' page URL

authMode.description: 'cookies' (recommended): injects a session exported from your logged-in browser — no password stored, and it skips Houzz's login screen entirely. 'login': signs in with the HOUZZ_EMAIL / HOUZZ_PASSWORD secret environment variables.
authMode.title: Authentication mode

cookiesJson.description: Only for 'cookies' mode. A JSON array of cookies exported from your logged-in browser (see README). Kept secret; never logged or written to the dataset.
cookiesJson.title: Houzz session cookies (JSON)

delayBetweenProjectsMs.description: Polite pause between uploads so Houzz doesn't throttle the session.
delayBetweenProjectsMs.title: Delay between projects (ms)

dryRun.description: Recommended for the first run: goes through login, photo upload and form filling, saves a screenshot per project, but does NOT publish anything.
dryRun.title: Dry run (fill forms, don't publish)

maxPhotosPerProject.description: Extra photo URLs beyond this are skipped. Keeps runs fast.
maxPhotosPerProject.title: Max photos per project

projects.description: One entry per project. Each needs a title and at least one photo URL.

description.description: A few sentences about the job: products installed, materials, scope.
description.title: Project description

photoCaptions.description: Optional caption per photo, in the same order as Photo URLs.
photoCaptions.title: Photo captions (optional)

photoUrls.description: Direct HTTPS links to the project photos. Each URL must download the image without a login (e.g. a public link or a Google Drive 'uc?export=download&id=…' link).
photoUrls.title: Photo URLs

location.description: Free-text location shown on the project (e.g. a zip code like 18966 or 'Maplewood, NJ'). Takes precedence over City/State when provided.
location.title: Location

year.description: 4-digit project year — fills Houzz's 'Project Year' dropdown. In Make: {{formatDate(appointment_date; "YYYY")}}.
year.title: Project year

keywords.description: Comma-separated keywords for Houzz's 'Keywords' field (max 300 characters).
keywords.title: Keywords

projects.title: Projects to add

reuseStoredCookies.description: After a successful run the actor stores the session cookies, so later runs can skip re-authentication even without new cookiesJson.
reuseStoredCookies.title: Reuse cookies saved from previous runs

proxyGroups.title: Apify Proxy groups
proxyGroups.description: Route browser traffic through Apify Proxy, e.g. ["RESIDENTIAL"] when Houzz blocks datacenter IPs (403 errors). Leave empty for a direct connection. Note: Apify meters proxy traffic.

proxyUrls.title: Custom proxy URLs (static residential)
proxyUrls.description: Route browser traffic through your own proxy, e.g. a static residential IP like ["http://user:pass@host:port"]. Takes precedence over Apify Proxy groups. Prefer the CUSTOM_PROXY_URL secret env var so credentials never land in the input JSON.

title: Houzz Project Uploader
